t: These Christmas light gutter hooks are designed to hang festive lights and decorations securely from outdoor guttering. Ideal for domestic decorators and trade professionals preparing residential properties for the festive season, these accessories ensure quick installation. The pack includes 24 clear plastic hooks that clip directly onto guttering, providing a simple mounting solution. Measuring 68 mm in length, these discreet clips hold string lights firmly in place without damaging drainage systems.
b: Clear Finish Offers Discreet & Subtle Appearance
Clip-on Design Simplifies Festive Light Installation
Pack of 24 Offers Ample Decoration Coverage
